description: Defines types, constants, and functions for handling time representations and conversions in the EzTime library, including structures for exploded time, time zones, and functions for getting current time, exploding, and imploding time values.

methods.name: EzTimeTFromSbTime
methods.description: Converts a 64-bit integer representing time in microseconds since Windows epoch to EzTimeT (seconds since Unix epoch). Lossy conversion.

methods.name: EzTimeTToSbTime
methods.description: Converts EzTimeT (seconds since Unix epoch) to a 64-bit integer representing time in microseconds since Windows epoch.

methods.name: EzTimeValueFromSbTime
methods.description: Converts a 64-bit integer time in microseconds to EzTimeValue (seconds + microseconds).

methods.name: EzTimeValueToSbTime
methods.description: Converts EzTimeValue to a 64-bit integer time in microseconds.

methods.name: EzTimeValueToEzTimeT
methods.description: Converts EzTimeValue to EzTimeT. Lossy conversion.

methods.name: EzTimeTExplode
methods.description: Explodes EzTimeT into EzTimeExploded structure for a given timezone.

methods.name: EzTimeValueExplode
methods.description: Explodes EzTimeValue into EzTimeExploded structure for a given timezone, with optional milliseconds.

methods.name: EzTimeTImplode
methods.description: Converts EzTimeExploded to EzTimeT for a given timezone.

methods.name: EzTimeValueImplode
methods.description: Converts EzTimeExploded and milliseconds to EzTimeValue for a given timezone.

methods.name: EzTimeValueGetNow
methods.description: Gets current time as EzTimeValue, always returns 0.

methods.name: EzTimeTExplodeLocal
methods.description: Explodes EzTimeT into local time EzTimeExploded.

methods.name: EzTimeTExplodeUTC
methods.description: Explodes EzTimeT into UTC time EzTimeExploded.

methods.name: EzTimeTImplodeLocal
methods.description: Converts local time EzTimeExploded to EzTimeT.

methods.name: EzTimeTImplodeUTC
methods.description: Converts UTC time EzTimeExploded to EzTimeT.
